# 命令行参考

`ipandora <子命令> [参数]`。每个子命令也可以用 `-h` 查看同样的内容。

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `-v`, `--verbosity` |  | log verbosity |
| `-V`, `--version` |  | print version |

## `ipandora check`

static checks of a case library: layout

### `ipandora check layout`

judgements only in tests/; no sleeps, no direct requests in cases, no fixed addresses in apis/. Exit 1 on any finding

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `directory` | `.` | the project root, holding apis/, pages/, flows/, tests/ |
| `--warn-only` |  | print the findings but exit 0, while a library is being moved over |

## `ipandora eval`

agent evaluation: run a spec, self-check references, label samples

### `ipandora eval agreement`

agreement and Cohen kappa between two raters

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `labels` |  | the labelled JSONL |
| `--a` `A` | `judge` | first rater column |
| `--b` `B` | `human` | second rater column |
| `--categorical` |  | compare categories (a three-level judge: --a judge_label), not yes/no |

### `ipandora eval code`

grade a coding agent's work directory: change scope, its tests, weakened judgements, mutation score; exit 1 if any check fails

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `dir` |  | the work directory (a git repository for --base) |
| `--base` `REF` |  | compare the changes with this commit |
| `--allow` `GLOB` |  | changes must stay inside these paths |
| `--forbid` `GLOB` |  | paths that must not change |
| `--max-files` `MAX_FILES` |  |  |
| `--max-lines` `MAX_LINES` |  | lines added plus removed |
| `--tests` `PATH` |  | tests to run: they must pass and every one must judge something |
| `--targets` `PATH` |  | source files to mutate; the --tests must catch the mutants |
| `--baseline` `FILE` |  | judgement inventory (conf/judgements.json): the tests must not judge less. With --base it is read as committed there, not as the agent left it |
| `--min-score` `MIN_SCORE` | `0.6` | mutation score to reach (default 0.6) |
| `--max-mutants` `MAX_MUTANTS` | `40` | per target file (default 40) |
| `--allow-harness-changes` |  | do not fail when conftest.py, pytest.ini, pyproject.toml ... changed (checked by default with --base: code there runs inside the test run) |
| `--json` |  | print the checks as JSON, for coding.from_json() |

### `ipandora eval compare`

compare configurations run on the same tasks, every pair: paired difference and interval; exit 1 if not comparable

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `runs` |  | report.json of each run (two or more) |
| `--name` `NAME` |  | a name per run, in order (default: its harness) |

### `ipandora eval f2p`

judge an agent's reproduction tests by fail-to-pass, in place: exit 0 when F→P holds (give it a disposable copy of the workspace)

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `workdir` |  | the agent's workspace: a git repository at the base commit |
| `--fix` `FIX` |  | the official fix, a unified diff |
| `--task` `TASK` |  | a task directory (task.yaml): its fix.patch and test_cmd |
| `--base` `BASE` | `HEAD` | the commit the agent started from |
| `--test-cmd` `TEST_CMD` |  | how to run tests, with {test_files}; default: python -m pytest -q {test_files} |
| `--runs` `RUNS` | `3` | runs with the fix; a test failing in any is flaky |
| `--max-mutants` `MAX_MUTANTS` | `20` | mutants of the functions the fix touched, when F→P holds (0: none) |
| `--timeout` `TIMEOUT` | `600` | seconds per pytest run |
| `--json` |  | print the record and the checks as one JSON line |

### `ipandora eval f2p-selfcheck`

the F→P grader on known answers in a workspace at the base commit: oracle x3, noop, bad answers; exit 1 if any is misjudged

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `workdir` |  | the workspace at the base commit (reset after each case) |
| `--task` `TASK` |  | the task directory (task.yaml, fix.patch, reference_test.patch) |
| `--base` `BASE` | `HEAD` |  |
| `--runs` `RUNS` | `3` | runs with the fix, per case |
| `--oracle-runs` `ORACLE_RUNS` | `3` | times the reference tests are graded |
| `--timeout` `TIMEOUT` | `600` |  |

### `ipandora eval inspect`

read Inspect logs as an evaluation run: report, baseline, gate (needs the inspect extra)

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `logs` |  | .eval / .json log files, or a directory of them |
| `--threshold` `[SCORER=]VALUE` |  | the value a score must reach to pass, on Inspect's scale (CORRECT = 1, PARTIAL = 0.5). Default 1. Repeat per scorer |
| `--judge` `SCORER` |  | a scorer that asks a model: shown, counted only once calibrated. model_graded_qa and model_graded_fact always are |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` |  | where report.html and report.json go. Default: the report archive |
| `--title` `TITLE` |  | report title |
| `--baseline` `PATH` |  | evaluation baseline. Default: conf/eval_baseline.json when it exists |
| `--no-baseline` |  | compare with nothing |
| `--update-baseline` |  | write this run as the baseline. Commit it; review its diff |
| `--noise` `RATE` |  | infrastructure noise as a rate (0.021 for ±2.1 points): a difference smaller than this is never called better or worse |
| `--fail-on-regression` `FAIL_ON_REGRESSION` | `overall` | what fails the run: overall -- the overall verdict is worse; tag -- also any tag value worse (corrected for the number of groups); task -- also any task that always succeeded and now always fails. Not comparable always fails |
| `--partial` |  | compare each task's partial score (the weighted share of its checks that held) instead of whether it succeeded |

### `ipandora eval records`

one JSON line per run (tokens, cost, how it ended, failure reason)

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `runs` |  | report.json of one or more runs |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` |  | file to write; default stdout |
| `--tasks` `TASKS` |  | task directories (task.yaml): their budgets flag over_budget |

### `ipandora eval run`

run every task k times, grade, compare with the baseline

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `spec` |  | the spec file: defines DATASET, agent and grade |
| `-k`, `--trials` `TRIALS` | `1` | trials per task |
| `--split` `SPLIT` |  | run one split only. Tune on dev; conclude on test |
| `-w`, `--workers` `WORKERS` | `1` | trials run at once (threads) |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` |  | where report.html and report.json go. Default: the report archive |
| `--title` `TITLE` |  | report title |
| `--baseline` `PATH` |  | evaluation baseline. Default: conf/eval_baseline.json when it exists |
| `--no-baseline` |  | compare with nothing |
| `--update-baseline` |  | write this run as the baseline. Commit it; review its diff |
| `--noise` `RATE` |  | infrastructure noise as a rate (0.021 for ±2.1 points): a difference smaller than this is never called better or worse |
| `--fail-on-regression` `FAIL_ON_REGRESSION` | `overall` | what fails the run: overall -- the overall verdict is worse; tag -- also any tag value worse (corrected for the number of groups); task -- also any task that always succeeded and now always fails. Not comparable always fails |
| `--partial` |  | compare each task's partial score (the weighted share of its checks that held) instead of whether it succeeded |

### `ipandora eval samples`

export judge verdicts for people to label (JSONL)

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `run` |  | report.json of an evaluation run |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` |  |  |
| `-n`, `--limit` `LIMIT` |  | sample this many rows |
| `--seed` `SEED` |  |  |
| `--all-checks` |  | include deterministic checks, to see whether people agree on a task |

### `ipandora eval selfcheck`

grade every reference solution; exit 1 if any fails

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `spec` |  |  |
| `--split` `SPLIT` |  |  |

### `ipandora eval to-inspect`

a dataset as Inspect samples (JSONL for json_dataset())

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `dataset` |  | dataset.yaml or .jsonl |
| `-o`, `--out` `OUT` |  | file to write; default stdout |
| `--split` `SPLIT` |  |  |

## `ipandora init`

start a test project: config, a passing example, AGENTS.md and CI with the gate

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `directory` | `.` | where to create the project. Default: the current directory |
| `--layout` `LAYOUT` | `minimal` | minimal: one example file. full: a layered case library -- apis/, flows/, pages/, data/, tests/api, tests/web, with pytest.ini -- whose examples log in as buyer and seller |
| `--force` |  | overwrite files that already exist. Without it they are kept |

## `ipandora mcp`

start the MCP server exposing IntelliPandora capabilities to AI clients

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `-t`, `--transport` `TRANSPORT` |  | MCP transport protocol. Default: value from conf/config.yaml (mcp.transport) |

## `ipandora merge`

merge the report.json of every shard into one report and one verdict

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `REPORT` |  | report.json files, or run directories holding one, one per shard |
| `-o`, `--out` `DIR` |  | where the merged report.html, report.json and report.xml go |
| `--title` `TITLE` |  | report title. Default: the first shard's |
| `--junit-xml` `PATH` |  | also write the merged JUnit XML here |
| `--fail-on-weakened` |  | exit non-zero when any shard judged less than the baseline |
| `--baseline` `PATH` |  | the judgement baseline (conf/judgements.json) the shards together cover. Every case it holds as passing that no shard reported is a deleted judgement -- this is what catches a shard whose report never arrived. Only pass it when the shards are the whole suite |
| `--compare-with` `REPORT` |  | an earlier (merged) report.json to compare failures with |
| `--allow-mixed-env` |  | merge shards that ran against different environments. Refused by default: one verdict over dev and staging is usually a mistake |

## `ipandora run`

run a suite and write its HTML report into the run history

| 参数 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `selector` |  | what to run: a path, a path::node, or a -k expression |
| `-e`, `--env` `ENV` | `` | environment name: overlays ./conf/<env>.yaml (or $IPANDORA_CONFIG_DIR/<env>.yaml) for this run, and is recorded in the report |
| `--title` `TITLE` |  | report title. Default: IntelliPandora Test Report |
| `-d`, `--report-dir` `REPORT_DIR` |  | where reports go. Default: $IPANDORA_REPORTS_DIR or ~/.ipandora/reports |
| `--no-archive` |  | write the report straight into --report-dir instead of into the run history |
| `--no-report` |  | run only; write no report |
| `--exclude-flaky` |  | skip cases marked @pytest.mark.flaky(reason=...). This is what a gate runs: a known-unstable case must not be able to fail a build. Without it they run and count normally |
| `--junit-xml` `PATH` |  | also write JUnit XML here, for CI and report viewers. One is already written beside every report; this puts a copy where the pipeline expects it |
| `--baseline` `PATH` |  | judgement inventory to compare with. Default: conf/judgements.json in the project config dir, when it exists |
| `--compare-with` `REPORT` |  | an earlier report.json (or the run directory holding it) to compare failures with: new, still failing, recovered. In CI, typically the last report from the main branch. Default: the previous run of the same selector and environment in the local report archive, when this machine has one; otherwise no comparison. The committed baseline is compared either way |
| `--no-baseline` |  | do not compare judgements with any baseline |
| `--update-baseline` |  | accept this run's judgements as the new baseline, and write every matches_golden() image as its new golden. Commit both: their diff is what a reviewer reads to see which judgements changed |
| `--fail-on-weakened` |  | exit non-zero when judgements got weaker than the baseline -- removed, loosened, changed, newly skipped or excluded, or a case that passes without judging anything. The gate for suites that agents edit |
| `-w`, `--workers` `N|auto` |  | run in parallel with N worker processes (pytest-xdist), or "auto" for one per CPU. Judgements, the report and the baseline comparison are the same as a serial run. Cases that share an account or other fixed data declare it with @pytest.mark.resource("name") and never run at the same time. Needs: pip install intellipandora[parallel] |
| `--timeout` `SECONDS` |  | fail any single case that runs longer than this (pytest-timeout); triage blames the environment. Needs: pip install intellipandora[parallel] |
| `--no-store` |  | do not keep the raw run for explain_failure |
| `--no-ai` |  | skip LLM root cause even when ai.enabled is set |
| `-p`, `--pytest-arg` `PYTEST_ARG` |  | extra argument passed through to pytest; repeatable |
